name: HD 202673

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list TOI-2374 and HD 202673 in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 6828814283414902912 and 6828814283414902784), 3,045 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 3.3e-5: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to TOI-2374, 3,045 AU away.

text.card: HD 202673 is a star of 6,289 K, bound to TOI-2374 3,045 AU away.
text.introduction: HD 202673 shares its motion through space with TOI-2374, 3,045 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: HD 202673's orbit around TOI-2374 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
